depiction.primary_object: rounded square frame containing three horizontal text lines
modifiers: circular badge with a plus sign at bottom right
depiction.composition: single bordered card or note with bottom-right corner badge

readings.meaning: create a new note, document, or list
write a new post, article, or text entry
add an item to a checklist or menu

ambiguity: Shares the identical rounded-square three-line base with the arrow, user, and ellipsis variants; at small sizes the white plus sign inside the dark circle is easily confused with the diagonal arrow of the export-note icon.

reasoning: Shows a square bordered text card or note with a plus badge, clearly reading as 'new note', 'new list', or 'create post/document'. It fits many everyday writing, listing, and documentation tasks, though it competes with several nearly identical document-plus icons.
